title: Fully faithful pullback of descent data along an fpqc singleton covering
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $a:X\to S$ be a morphism, and let the singleton family $\{r:X'\to X\}$ be an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], and regard $X'$ as a scheme over $S$ via $a\circ r$. Pullback along $r$ induces a functor $DD(X/S)\to DD(X'/S)$ from descent data for $X/S$ to descent data for $X'/S$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. This functor is fully faithful. Here $DD(X/S)$ denotes the category whose objects are the descent data $(V,\varphi)$ on schemes $V$ over $X$ relative to $X/S$ [def-pd-descent-datum] and whose morphisms $(V,\varphi)\to(W,\psi)$ are the morphisms $\alpha:V\to W$ over $X$ with $\psi\circ\mathrm{pr}_0^*\alpha=\mathrm{pr}_1^*\alpha\circ\varphi$; for a morphism $r:T\to X$ over $S$ (with $T\to S$ the given structure map), the pullback of $(V,\varphi)$ along $r$ is $(T\times_XV,(r\times r)^*\varphi)$ [def-pc-fibre-product], where $r\times r:T\times_ST\to X\times_SX$, and the pullback of $\alpha$ is $\mathrm{id}_T\times_X\alpha$.

source.place: Descent, Lemma Tag 0241 (lemma-fully-faithful), assumptions (1)--(2) and conclusion

proof.text: Let $(V,\varphi)$ and $(W,\psi)$ be descent data over $X/S$, put $T=X'$, $V'=T\times_XV$, $W'=T\times_XW$, $\varphi'=(r\times r)^*\varphi$, $\psi'=(r\times r)^*\psi$, and let $\beta:V'\to W'$ be a morphism over $T$ with $\psi'\circ\mathrm{pr}_0^*\beta=\mathrm{pr}_1^*\beta\circ\varphi'$ over $T\times_ST$. Let $j:T\times_XT\to T\times_ST$ be the morphism induced by the identities of $T$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and $\rho=r\circ\mathrm{pr}_0:T\times_XT\to X$. Then $\mathrm{pr}_k\circ j$ are the two projections of $T\times_XT$, so $j^*\mathrm{pr}_k^*\beta=\mathrm{pr}_k^*\beta$ for $k=0,1$; and $(r\times r)\circ j=\Delta\circ\rho$ with $\Delta:X\to X\times_SX$ the diagonal, so $j^*\varphi'=\rho^*\Delta^*\varphi$ up to the canonical identifications of fibre products. By [lem-galois-descent-datum-diagonal-identity], $\Delta^*\varphi=\mathrm{id}_V$ and $\Delta^*\psi=\mathrm{id}_W$, so $j^*\varphi'$ and $j^*\psi'$ are the canonical isomorphisms $\mathrm{can}_V$, $\mathrm{can}_W$ of $V\times_XT$, $W\times_XT$ over $T\times_XT$. Pulling the compatibility equation of $\beta$ back along $j$ therefore gives $\mathrm{can}_W\circ\mathrm{pr}_0^*\beta=\mathrm{pr}_1^*\beta\circ\mathrm{can}_V$ over $T\times_XT$, which is the overlap equation of [lem-galois-fpqc-morphisms-descend] for the base $X$ and the cover $\{r:T\to X\}$ (identifying $T\times_XV$ with $V\times_XT$ by the symmetry of fibre products).

source.place: Descent, Lemma Tag 0241, proof: compatibility of a morphism of pulled-back descent data on the double overlap

proof.text: Apply [lem-galois-fpqc-morphisms-descend] with base scheme $S=X$, fpqc singleton cover $\{r:X'\to X\}$, and schemes $V,W$ over $X$. The overlap equality of Step 1 gives a unique morphism $\alpha:V\to W$ over $X$ whose pullback $\mathrm{id}_{X'}\times_X\alpha$ is $\beta$.

source.place: Descent, Lemma Tag 0241, proof via Lemma Tag 02W0 (fpqc descent of morphisms)

proof.text: The morphism $\alpha$ is a morphism of descent data, i.e. the two morphisms $\psi\circ\mathrm{pr}_0^*\alpha$ and $\mathrm{pr}_1^*\alpha\circ\varphi$ from $\mathrm{pr}_0^*V$ to $\mathrm{pr}_1^*W$ over $X_2=X\times_SX$ agree. The morphism $r\times r:T\times_ST\to X_2$ is the composite of $u=\mathrm{id}_X\times_Sr:X\times_ST\to X_2$ and $v=r\times_S\mathrm{id}_T:T\times_ST\to X\times_ST$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. $u$ is the base change of $r$ along $\mathrm{pr}_1:X_2\to X$ and $v$ is the base change of $r$ along the first projection $X\times_ST\to X$, so $\{u\}$ and $\{v\}$ are fpqc coverings by [lem-galois-fpqc-covering-base-change] applied to the singleton covering $\{r\}$. Pulled back along $r\times r$ (by functoriality of fibre products and the definitions of $\varphi',\psi'$, and since $\mathrm{id}_T\times_X\alpha=\beta$ by Step 2), the two morphisms become $\psi'\circ\mathrm{pr}_0^*\beta$ and $\mathrm{pr}_1^*\beta\circ\varphi'$, which are equal by the compatibility of $\beta$. The injectivity clause of [lem-galois-fpqc-morphisms-descend], applied first with base $X\times_ST$ and cover $\{v\}$ and then with base $X_2$ and cover $\{u\}$, shows that the two morphisms already agree over $X_2$. Hence every compatible $\beta$ is the pullback of a morphism $\alpha$ of descent data (fullness). Finally, if two morphisms $\alpha,\alpha'$ of descent data have $\mathrm{id}_T\times_X\alpha=\mathrm{id}_T\times_X\alpha'$, then $\alpha=\alpha'$ by the injectivity clause of [lem-galois-fpqc-morphisms-descend] with base $X$ and cover $\{r\}$ (faithfulness).
